snippet.title: Too Many Bots - Gameplay
snippet.description:
🎮 Dive into a dark, retro PSX-style arcade maze!
Experience a fast-paced horror arcade where Pac-Man meets Vampire Survivors. Run, collect power-ups, and survive terrifying monsters in unique mazes.

🕹️ Coming soon on Steam!
